name: attendance_notice_to_improve
description: Notice to improve: the final warning before a penalty-notice referral to the local authority.
subject: Notice to improve - {pupil_name}
body: This is a formal notice to improve {first_name}'s attendance.
{first_name}'s attendance from {period} is {attendance_pct}%. {first_name} has missed {sessions_missed} sessions (half-days), {unauthorised} of them unauthorised.
Support has been offered to help improve attendance. Parents have a legal duty to make sure their child attends school regularly.

If {first_name}'s attendance does not improve during the improvement period, the school may refer the matter to the local authority, which can issue a penalty notice or take other legal action. Please contact us if you need help.

placeholders.pupil_name: The pupil's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.details: Meeting date, the agreed target and any extra note
